style.backgroundSystem: a pale misty-sage plate #E6E9E1 and a deep chestnut-husk field #3A251F alternate screen by screen, with one warm taupe-grey mid plane #B9A79C reserved for the pain-point and variant screens; every screen keeps the same narrow persimmon #DE7436 ribbon spine on the left margin plus one chamfered contrast block at a lower corner, so no screen reads as a flat single colour and no screen is a full-bleed two-field split either; no third backdrop, no gradient wash, no glossy mirror floor, no photographic wall scenery behind infographic copy
style.direction: warm morning-kitchen counter appliance ecommerce, misty-sage plate plus chestnut-husk deep field, persimmon ribbon-spine blank-plaque infographic system
style.iconSystem: solid chamfered persimmon #DE7436 ribbon tabs carrying an unfilled numeral well with no digit drawn, blank arch-topped plaques and image windows with no glyph inside, solid right-angle bracket leaders terminated by small open square stops, blank ruled spec rows with empty cells, small chamfered arrow chips; no hollow icon rings, no dotted leader lines, no hairline-inset square plaques, no filled 3D icons, no seal artwork, no check marks
style.lightingSystem: warm studio key from the upper right at 3400-4000K with one large bounce fill on the shadow side, a thin persimmon rim separation on dark fields and exactly one honest contact shadow under the base; macro screens use a low raking warm beam from the right; scene screens keep the same upper-right direction under soft daylight; no ember bloom, no atmospheric haze, no coloured gels across the product, no left-side key
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm morning-kitchen small-appliance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a pale misty-sage plate #E6E9E1, a deep chestnut-husk field #3A251F, one warm taupe-grey mid plane #B9A79C and one persimmon accent #DE7436; warm upper-right key at 3400-4000K with a large bounce fill on the shadow side, a thin persimmon rim on dark fields and exactly one honest contact shadow under the base; matte warm micro-cement deck #CBBFB4 with fine silica speckle, never marble, slate, brushed steel or lilac stoneware; modern geometric sans-serif with a wide-tracked Latin kicker above a two-line headline slot; chapter grammar of solid chamfered persimmon ribbon tabs with an unfilled numeral well, blank arch-topped plaques and image windows with no glyph inside, solid right-angle bracket leaders ending in small open square stops, and blank ruled spec rows with empty cells; a narrow persimmon ribbon spine stays on the left margin of every screen together with one chamfered contrast block at a lower corner; the product is always one upright vessel-on-base silhouette on a stable central axis at constant scale, every dial, screen and graduation left blank and unlit; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no lit readouts, no hollow rings or dotted leaders.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no gold, champagne, citron or signal-red accent replacing the persimmon #DE7436 ribbon
no lilac stoneware plate, porcelain-blue plate, pine-green or charcoal-plum deep field replacing the chestnut-husk #3A251F field
no mixed fonts, no readable lettering, no wordmark, no pinyin mark, no model or part number in frame
no lit display digits, no dial tick readings, no graduation marks on the vessel wall, no glyph drawn inside the blank arch-topped plaques
no hollow icon rings, no dotted leader lines, no hairline-inset square plaques, no rounded-corner image cards replacing the arch-topped windows
no key light drifting to the left, no missing contact shadow, no glossy mirror floor, no duplicated product body or duplicated blade arms
style.presentationRules: the product is always read as one upright vessel-on-base silhouette on a stable central axis, its scale held constant between screens; the packshot and the chapter hero keep the same straight-on or low-axis reading of that silhouette; every dial ring, button face, display area and inner-wall graduation stays blank and unlit with no digits, ticks or readouts; only hands or wrists may enter frame and never a face
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm micro-cement deck #CBBFB4 speckled with fine silica, one pale grooved ceramic trivet, and an untextured neutral graphic board #E6E9E1 for infographic screens; never marble veining, never honed slate tile, never a brushed steel riser, never a lilac stoneware plate, never walnut butcher block, never rattan or bamboo
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif only, one wide-tracked Latin kicker line above a two-line Chinese headline slot, headline in #3A251F on the sage plate and in #E6E9E1 on the chestnut field, three-layer copy budget kept short, Chinese copy always wrapped in 「」 and always a placeholder
